en.headline: Six-year-old girl in critical condition with influenza A shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection reported a healthy six-year-old girl developed shock from influenza A and remains in paediatric intensive care.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said a previously healthy six-year-old girl was admitted to Tuen Mun Hospital on 15 October with fever, runny nose, vomiting and loss of appetite. Her condition worsened on 17 October and she was transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit, where she remains in critical condition.

Laboratory tests confirmed influenza A (H1). The girl had not travelled during the incubation period and had not received the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine. Household contacts have shown no symptoms so far.

Director of the Centre for Health Protection Tsui Lok-kin noted that the influenza season has lasted more than three months since late June, with activity still high. There have been 24 severe paediatric influenza cases this season, and nearly 440 school outbreaks affecting about 2,700 people since the start of term.

zh.headline: 六歲女童染甲型流感併發休克 情況危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心錄得一宗兒童感染流感嚴重個案，一名健康良好的六歲女童因甲型流感併發休克，留醫兒童深切治療部，情況危殆。
body: 衞生防護中心表示，該名過往健康良好的六歲女童於本月十五日因發燒、流鼻水、嘔吐及食慾不振，到屯門醫院急症室求診並留院。十七日情況轉壞，轉往兒童深切治療部，現時情況危殆。
化驗證實對甲型H1流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發休克。女童潛伏期內沒有外遊，尚未接種本年度季節性流感疫苗，家居接觸者暫無病徵。
中心總監徐樂堅指，本港自六月下旬進入流感季節已逾三個月，活躍程度仍高。今季累計二十四宗兒童嚴重個案，開學後近四百四十宗學校爆發，影響約二千七百人。
